The '''Imperial siege balloon''' was a retrofitted [[Freighter/Legends|barge]] model used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:ThCA3QH0Y7.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Imperial siege balloons]]
Imperial siege balloons were circular weapons platforms suspended under large parasols by wires, powered by three exposed [[Engine/Legends|gas jets]].<ref name="RS II guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref> The Imperial configuration saw each platform mounted with six perimeter laser cannons.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

The gaps between the wires were wide enough to allow an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] to fly through.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

==History==
Prior to the Empire's [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation of Bespin]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation of Bespin]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the balloons were used as [[Floating health spa|floating health spas]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

At least 20 Imperial siege balloons were deployed around [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance’s]] [[Raid on Bespin|attempt to secure Tibanna gas]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" /> The Imperials directed the balloons’ cannons at their own [[Tibanna gas platform|tibanna gas platforms]], choosing to destroy them rather than risk Rebel capture.<ref name="RS II guide" /> [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] targeted the balloons’ vulnerable gas burners, destroying the entire fleet and securing the Tibanna platforms for the Alliance.<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial siege balloons first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (series)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series, making it's debut in [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]],<ref name="SW:RSII:RL" /> and later re-appearing in the co-op mode of ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.<ref name="SW:RSIII:RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>
